instruction.text:
Fill in the gaps to complete the following stylistic devices.

alliteration - onomatopoeia

atoms.b: Sophie’s ((++spotless lovely new)) café ((++sat was kept)) ((++silent colourful rainy)), though she’d brewed the best beans in town. The espresso machine ((hissed was_loud was_turned_off)) and steamed and ((sighed made_coffee broke)) like a tired dragon. Day after day, Sophie waited for customers who never arrived, as if she'd been standing in that café for a thousand years. She always said, ‘Good things come to those who wait’, yet no one came. Her empty tables had become monuments to broken dreams.

instruction.text: Read the text and choose three words which make up an assonance.

hint.text:
There are three words in total. One is in the first sentence and the other two are in the second sentence.

The assonance comes from the repeated long “ee” vowel sound (/iː/).
